test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 497 581 452 460 775 (Right)

(Example: 697 - First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (Note: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if second digit of the highest number is subtracted from the second digit of the lowest number?
solution:
As per the question,

Given Numbers: 497 581 452 460 775

Rule: Subtract the second digit of the highest number from the second digit of the lowest number.

→ Highest number: 775
